explication: Memanto is a companion memory agent for managing shared agent memory: capturing and curating knowledge, reconciling conflicts, applying forgetting policies, briefing agents, and moving data between systems. Its main user workflow runs through the CLI and local service/API; optional framework integrations expose Memanto to agent runtimes. The README documents several product capabilities whose detailed wiring is not shown in the sampled source, so those branches are represented at subsystem level and uncertain links are omitted.
